data.description: Owns journal schema compatibility, integrity checks, crash-consistent machine-local backup and validated restore, writer maintenance gates, and compaction mechanics. It compacts only event-committer-marked terminal or superseded facts after the safety horizon, preserves pending/undelivered/uncertain or quarantined evidence, and never interprets portable history or creates operational transitions
data.technology: PortableRuntimeJournalMaintenancePort over SQLite backup, integrity, migration, and retention primitives
